title: Nine Seasons of Hiring
subtitle: 教练与指导 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 教练与指导（文学艺术与体育·体育与训练）
meta: 主题语境：教练与指导（文学艺术与体育·体育与训练）　|　核心词汇：coach　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 coach 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1947 my mother was sent to hire ① coach she could not pay, and she said the hiring was the whole of the lesson. The ② coach, meaning the trainer and not the bus, was nine seasons in the game and was hired by whoever came last; coach, she said, is the only thing in a club that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ coach in that club had the same whistle, and the ④ coach at the end, meaning the one the chairman kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever hired properly. Coach, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ coach was the whole of the journey, meaning the carriage it carried and not the trainer. The ⑥ coach, meaning the carriage and not any of that, is the only thing in a journey that everybody waits for and nobody questions; coach, he said, is either something you hire or the only word that means both a trainer and a carriage. She said the carriage is the part they remember.

By 1962 the ⑦ coach had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the whistle. The ⑧ coach of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine seasons and eleven years of hiring; coach, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ coach I remember is the one at the end, which was hired in 1967 and is still described as the strictest in the county. A ⑩ coach, my grandmother said in 1972, is the only thing that improves by being hired; every coach, she said, is a carriage that has agreed to look like a trainer. She said the carriage was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 教练（指那位教练本人，与那辆客车相对）
C. 固定搭配：hire a coach 聘用一位教练
D. n. 教练（指那家俱乐部里每一位）
E. n. 教练（指末尾那一位）
F. n. 马车；长途客车（抽象：它承载的那节车厢）
G. n. 那节车厢（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The coach, meaning the trainer and not the bus
coach was the whole of the journey
the coach had become a number in a report
The coach of the whole thing

answers.why: hire a coach 意为“聘用一位教练”，1947 年母亲被派去聘用她付不起工钱的那位教练。
coach 意为“教练”，指那位教练本人而不是那辆客车，在这一行干了九个赛季，由最后来的人聘用。
coach 指那家俱乐部里每一位教练，每一位都是同样的哨子。
coach 指末尾那一位（主席留下的那一位），是唯一有人认真聘用过的。
coach 意为“马车、长途客车”，抽象指它承载的那节车厢，父亲说 coach 就是那段旅程的全部。
coach 为抽象用法，指那节车厢本身，是一段旅程里人人都等、却没人质疑的东西。
coach 意为“教练”，到 1962 年这位 coach 成了报告里的一个数字。
coach 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九个赛季和十一年的聘用。
coach 意为“教练”，我记得的是末尾那一位，1967 年聘用，至今仍被说成全县最严的。
coach 为抽象总称，祖母说一位教练是唯一会因为被认真聘用而变好的东西。
